responsibility: Defines the move-path model and lookup tables used by MIR move and initialization analyses. It owns the indexed representations of places, moves, and inits; provides place-to-path lookup and tree traversal utilities; records illegal move metadata; and exposes `MoveData::gather_moves` as the entry point for constructing this state.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the move-path subsystem root, defining the indexed place/move/init model and lookup tables that initialization-oriented analyses depend on. Other dataflow `mod.rs` files either define the abstract framework or the analyses built atop this structure, rather than the path representation itself.
